data.summary: The Global Muster Research Institute confirms Daniel O'Connor's place in its summer research programme and asks him to return the signed participation form by 07/08/2026, after which late forms cannot be considered.
data.explanation: This letter confirms your acceptance into the summer research programme. You need to sign and return the participation form by the stated deadline; if it arrives later, the institute says it cannot be considered. Since this deadline is an explicit date printed in the letter, check whether it has already passed and, if so, contact the institute directly to ask whether a late submission is still possible.
